statement: Explicit application-contract addendum: the independent-row-tag proposal and P+B*D/y+L numeric models retain at most one checked relation per fresh private-coefficient query. Multiple outputs from one query share tags; a nonzero row-kernel vector alone may have zero query-aggregate vector and a deterministically zero denominator. Multi-output batching remains open and requires separate total-work/output accounting and a nonzero tag-blind query aggregate; probability yield is capped at one, while expected row counts can exceed one. The original frozen drafts/theorems retain their bytes; actual point/selection/probability and algorithmic cost bridges remain open. The F5 witness is separately certified; no novelty or changed exponent is established.
